findings.why: The post's canonical URL and the slug it implies are not among the site's listed pages in the ficha, so the structured data points to a route the site does not have.
findings.fix: Add this post's route to the site's page list or change the slug and canonical URL to a route that exists, and use the same value in the BlogPosting url and mainEntityOfPage fields.

findings.quote: Our front desk can also check benefits for your plan.
findings.why: The ficha says the front desk checks benefits only with Delta Dental, Cigna or MetLife, and this sentence could be read as acceptance of any plan.
findings.fix: Replace it with wording that names only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife, for example: "Our front desk can check your benefits with Delta Dental, Cigna or MetLife."
